verdict.rationale: The entire product is built as agent-oriented docs — SKILL.md files explicitly written to be read and followed by coding agents (Claude Code, etc.), installed via `npx skills add` or the Claude plugin marketplace, and a real runtime probe confirms an agent can fetch and read these files non-interactively. However, there is no evidence of an actual llms.txt file for this product (the probe for github.com/mattpocock/skills.md returns 404, and the llms.txt hit is GitHub's own unrelated file), so the 'llms.txt' half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: a dedicated llms.txt endpoint for the product, and independent confirmation that agents can be pointed at the docs site (aihero.dev/skills) directly rather than only via the CLI install flow.
